current.name: The Awakening Rework
current.notes:
🌅 *FULL REWORK SHIPPED.*

💎 *Shards & merge* — defeat mergeable wild Mora to crystallize their essence into shards. *.awaken <shard>* shatters one and your form becomes theirs. *.shed* reverts.

🥋 *10 fighting styles* — Wind Step, Sun Walk, Tide Veil, Bone Crush, Void Sever + 5 new Greek/Latin styles: Pyrolexis, Kataphraxis, Tenebris, Astrobolos, Anastasis. Rarity tiers buff damage (rare +5%, epic +12%, legendary +22%).

📜 *Quests via scrolls* — 12 scrolls drop on wild defeats. *.open <name>* DMs you the quest details + a hidden whisper command for chained NPC steps.

🌀 *Player IS the combatant* — wild battles AND PvP (*.battle @user*) both use the new engine. No more party Mora in combat. Stats apply on both sides.

📊 *4 stats* (Melee / Mora / Vit / Speed). Each grants 3 points per level up. *.invest <cat> <n>* to distribute. Melee = +dmg AND +stamina. Vit = +10 HP/pt (no separate Def — Vit absorbed it).

⚔️ *PvP rework* — *.battle @user [stake]* now uses the same engine as wild. Optional Lucons stake, status moves, dodge, rarity buffs all live.

🌐 *Auto-raids* — Kael's teleporter spawns autonomously every 4-10h. First *.respond <victim>* names a different faction; victim must *.engage* Kael together.

🌿 *Faction rites on corrupted shards*: Harmony *.purify*, Purity *.destroy*, Rift *.bind*.

🎁 *Apology gift* — wiped players get 500 Lucons + a rare/epic shard 48 days after launch.

🆕 *Starter pickers* — every new player chooses 1 of 3 starter styles + 1 of 3 starter shards at .start.

🛒 *New items* — Cleansing Vial, Shard Lure, Anastasis Draught, Surge Tonic, Resonance Vial, Reader's Ink, Quest Compass, Sun-Dew Tincture.

💯 Level cap: 100. Linear XP curve.
